facts.fact: 第六任妻子 Adria 死去仅几小时，Council 已开始筹备下一季选后。
facts.anchor: My wife had been dead only a few hours

facts.fact: Orin 进屋禀报：送葬队 Reapers 已聚集，急于筹备葬礼。
facts.anchor: The Reapers have gathered. They are eager to begin preparations for the funeral.

facts.fact: Vastion 愤怒于传统的机器：尸体会被抽干血以「不浪费资源」。
facts.anchor: They would drain her blood, reclaiming every drop so as not to waste resources

facts.fact: 王传唤 Lailanor（Laila）来向 Adria 做她自己的告别——她是 Adria 的贴身女仆。
Orin 对床单行吻手礼向女王致哀——Vampyr 只在人类看着时才向人类王后行礼。
facts.anchor: placing a kiss on his knuckles before resting them gently against the silk of the sheet. A silent, sacred tribute to our Queen.

facts.fact: Adria 是 Lyr 领地来的 Tribute（贡选新娘），伴王已五十余年。
facts.anchor: She was a Tribute from Lyr

facts.fact: 当年选妃评估时 Adria 无惧无怵（瞳孔不放缩、脉搏不加速），成了 Kesna 背叛后「最安全」的选择。
facts.anchor: Her pupils didn’t dilate; her pulse didn’t quicken.

facts.fact: 往事：亲兄弟与妻子 Kesna 的背叛几乎毁掉他；妹妹 Samina 与 Adria、Orin 把他从自我厌弃中拉回。
facts.anchor: My own brother. My own wife. The betrayal had nearly claimed me.

facts.fact: 章末：Forlorn 阴影迫近，寻找第七任新娘的搜选开始了。
facts.anchor: The search for the seventh bride had begun.
